title: Schedule of Swap Fee Levels after Recent Vehicle Changes, Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
**Swap fee level — Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement.**

| Vehicle swap fees posted on the agreement | Swap fee level |
|---|---|
| One or more in the last 12 months | the class's vehicle swap fee plus $10.00 (repeat-swap step) |
| None in the last 12 months, but one or more in the last 24 months | the class's vehicle swap fee plus $5.00 (returning-swap step) |
| None in the last 24 months | no adjustment under this schedule |

A window of the last 12 months covers entries dated less than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date, whole months being counted to the same day of the later month. The 24-month window is counted the same way. A swap fee is placed in a window by its posting date; the swap now requested is not yet posted and is not counted.

**Levels by class.**

| Space class | Class vehicle swap fee | With repeat-swap step | With returning-swap step |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space | $15.00 | $25.00 | $20.00 |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | $25.00 | $35.00 | $30.00 |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | $25.00 | $35.00 | $30.00 |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | $25.00 | $35.00 | $30.00 |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | $25.00 | $35.00 | $30.00 |
| Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage | $25.00 | $35.00 | $30.00 |

Hypothetical reading: a swap fee posted 15 months before the handling date and none since places a Bluegate Uncovered Car Space at $20.00.
